title: Blaze post kit v1
description: One post kit for a creator's photo, video still or idea. Client-neutral: Desktop, Mobile, CLI and the gateway post-kit tool all produce exactly this shape. Copy-out only: nothing here is ever posted by Blaze. Length limits count Unicode code points, except X, which counts every URL as 23 characters (t.co).

language.description: BCP 47 tag of the creator's language (e.g. en, fr, sw, bem). Every text field is written in it.

idea.description: What the creator typed, kept as given.

hook.description: Opening line shared by all platforms: at most 12 words (whitespace-separated), no hashtags.

hashtags.description: Exactly 3 hashtags, each with a leading #, no spaces or punctuation.

alt_text.description: Always present. Describes the image (or the idea when there is no image) for screen readers, at most 125 characters.

platforms.description: Only the platforms the creator chose. caption includes the hook if the platform shows it, and the hashtags if they're used inline.

youtube_shorts.description: YouTube Shorts: title <= 100 (in caption); optional description <= 5000.

reddit.description: Reddit: title <= 300 (in title); caption is the body <= 40000.

x.description: Crop rectangle in source-image pixels; the original is never modified.

file.description: Exported file name when saved (client side), e.g. sunset-4x5.jpg.

focus.description: Subject centre as fractions of width and height; crops keep it centred where they can.

title.description: Only where the platform has titles (Reddit; YouTube Shorts uses caption as the title).

x-blaze-rules.preserve: Every URL, @handle, email, {placeholder}, {{placeholder}} and `code` in the idea must appear unchanged in each caption that has room; never shorten or rewrite them.
x-blaze-rules.trim: Over the limit, cut at a sentence or word boundary before the limit and never inside a preserved token.
x-blaze-rules.privacy: Images are processed on the device. A client may send the image only through its normal chat model call; crops never leave the device.
x-blaze-rules.posting: Copy-out only. No client posts on the creator's behalf.
